stages.observation: README.md persona row names the Elasticsearch path: ./start-services.sh --elasticsearch-local plus configs/elasticsearch/example-local.yaml, and links docs/user-guide/elasticsearch-setup.md.

elasticsearch-setup.md has the operator headings Choose your deployment, Environment variables, Path A — local Docker, Path B — bring your own, Index lifecycle, Before you run a sweep, Run the smoke sweep, Switching backends, Sizing, Troubleshooting, Diagnostics cheat sheet, and Related docs. The guide states the default run-state pair is mongodb-local unless STORAGE_BACKEND=postgres.

Before teardown the stack had rag-params-finder-frontend, rag-params-finder-server, rag-params-finder-mongodb-local, rag-params-finder-elasticsearch-local (9.5.0), and rag-params-finder-postgres-local. Earlier the Docker VM disk filled and mongod exited on mongod.lock. Build cache was pruned and the MongoDB container was restarted; it then reported healthy. Volumes were not reset.

Command: env -u STORAGE_BACKEND -u VECTOR_STORE_BACKEND NONINTERACTIVE=1 ./start-services.sh --elasticsearch-local. No storage variable was exported by hand. GET /healthz returned 200, ok true, storage_mode elasticsearch-local, storage_backend mongodb, vector_store_backend elasticsearch, run_state_mode mongodb-local, and both stores ok. The Elasticsearch sweep submitted to that server is stamped storage_mode mongodb-local with database_provider elasticsearch (c7a8d278-4c55-4c4c-9cd4-b28a7b252ae1). The earlier one-shot that exported STORAGE_BACKEND=mongodb stays in compose_9_5_0.healthz_default_pair and is not this start.
rag-params-finder indexes list against that Elasticsearch server printed index rpf-chunks, fields embedding_1024 and embedding_384, type hnsw.

configs/elasticsearch/example-local.yaml submitted without a config-engine 422 and completed 120/120 (c7a8d278-4c55-4c4c-9cd4-b28a7b252ae1, example-elasticsearch-local_20260927-231453, 2026-09-27T23:14:53Z to 2026-09-28T00:00:39Z, 9240 result rows). The same YAML shape then completed 120/120 on MongoDB (f41d76f7-6881-4883-b806-bc4f2bf8d223, 2026-09-28T00:04:00Z to 2026-09-28T01:51:43Z) and on Postgres (72395ff5-bbf0-4423-a40c-a5e7a6b40b9b, example-supabase-local_20260928-070004, 2026-09-28T07:00:04Z to 2026-09-28T07:45:47Z). Postgres attempt cdd12d9f-b8fc-4888-9893-3683604b0d29 went partial when the Docker VM disk filled and was not used.
GET http://127.0.0.1:5374/ returned 200 while the frontend container was healthy during the Elasticsearch sweep.

GET /experiments/c7a8d278-4c55-4c4c-9cd4-b28a7b252ae1/db-stats during the Elasticsearch sweep returned database_provider elasticsearch, collection rpf-chunks, and host elasticsearch-local. That host is the compose service name, not a credential URI.

Full-grid top-3 overlap is in cross_backend_overlap_full_grid. Dense mean |A∩B|/3 is mongodb-postgres 0.8641, mongodb-elasticsearch 0.8636, postgres-elasticsearch 0.9994, each over 2310 pairs. The 2026-09-27 dense/fixed/512/50 measurement stays in cross_backend_overlap.

After the Elasticsearch grid, docker stop rag-params-finder-server rag-params-finder-frontend and ./start-services.sh --mongodb-local (STORAGE_BACKEND unset) served the MongoDB grid with storage_mode mongodb-local. ./start-services.sh --postgres-local then served the Postgres grid 72395ff5 with storage_mode postgres-local and database_provider postgres.
POST of a YAML with database_provider mongodb to the Elasticsearch server returned 422 naming configs/elasticsearch/example-local.yaml.
elasticsearch-setup.md contains Troubleshooting and Diagnostics cheat sheet.

NONINTERACTIVE=1 ./stop-services.sh ran after the three grids were saved. Compose down removed rag-params-finder-frontend, rag-params-finder-server, rag-params-finder-elasticsearch-local, rag-params-finder-mongodb-local, and rag-params-finder-postgres-local. docker ps then showed no rag-params-finder container. Volumes were not reset.

cross_backend_overlap_full_grid.method: Slice 38 shape: match (retriever type, chunking_method, chunk_size, overlap, whitespace-normalized query_text, persona_id); SHA1 of whitespace-normalized chunk text; mean |A∩B|/3. Retriever type is retrievers[0].type. retrieval_method is not used, because cross_encoder runs store retrieval_method dense and would overwrite dense keys.
cross_backend_overlap_full_grid.grid: example-local shape: 5 chunking methods x 3 chunk sizes x 2 overlaps x 4 retrievers = 120 runs. Retrievers are dense, sparse, hybrid, and cross_encoder (local MiniLM).

postgres.not_used: cdd12d9f-b8fc-4888-9893-3683604b0d29 went partial when the Docker VM disk filled and is not in these figures

cross_backend_overlap_full_grid.caveat: Dense is the comparability figure the scenario asks for. Postgres sparse is mostly empty results, so its overlap near 0.007 is an empty-list result, not a rank disagreement. MongoDB dense returned no hits for 285 of 2310 query-runs, which pulls its dense overlap with the other two stores down from the postgres-elasticsearch figure.
